target_customer: Low-carbon fuel and energy producers and other heavy industry firms that must file regulatory compliance reports (customers named on site include Valero and Enbridge)
problem: Compliance reporting needs data scattered across PDFs, spreadsheets, sensors and ERP systems, which is manual and error prone.
business_model: AI compliance and operations data platform for regulated industry reporting (pricing not public)
product_category: Industrial compliance data and reporting software

founders.name: Timothy Daniel
prior_employers: A mining and energy company (unnamed), Head of Compliance and Legal Counsel
founders.background_notes: YC bio says ex-head of compliance overseeing reporting and audit for energy and mining supply chains.

founders.name: Akshay Sharma
founders.background_notes: YC page lists first name only; surname from the Berkeley Haas feature.

competitors.name: Gecko Robotics
competitors.what: Adjacent industrial inspection robots plus AI analysis platform, not compliance reporting
competitors.traction_then: Launched an AI-driven data collection and analysis platform in 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting structured data from messy documents and plant systems and mapping it to regulatory programs such as LCFS and RFS is standard AI engineering with heavy integration and domain rules.

defensibility.rationale: Audit-ready workflows tied to specific regulations and customer systems create stickiness, but no direct competitor analysis or patents were found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent is documented offering the same compliance wedge; no source shows any acquisition as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Low-carbon fuel programs (LCFS, RFS, ISCC, 45Z) impose recurring audit-ready reporting duties, and the founder lived this as a compliance lead.

identity.logo: A logo exists but no source describes it
identity.voice_and_tone: Industrial and professional, tagline Where Heavy Industry Meets AI Automation

branding.community_and_virality: Berkeley Haas newsroom feature and a Poets and Quants listing of 2025 most disruptive MBA startups; Biofuels Digest guide to the company

brand_strength.rationale: Some trade and school press about the company but no evidence the name or identity itself carries weight.

outcome_analysis: Rimba is an early company active as of late 2026 with named industry customers on its site and Berkeley competition prizes totaling a reported $175,000. The founder's compliance background gives domain fit, but funding amounts and revenue are not public, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Funding: VCBacked lists a June 2025 pre-seed with Y Combinator and Team Ignite Ventures, amount undisclosed, and the site says it is backed by Y Combinator, Gumi, NFX, Launch, Progressive Ventures and Ignite Ventures; no amounts or dates were verified, so no round is recorded. Berkeley prize totals differ by source ($175,000 vs $150,000). Founder education is not stated on the YC page. No close dated competitor in compliance reporting was found, Gecko is adjacent.
